name: Pay with ConnectIPS
author: codemanas

sections.description:
Pay with ConnectIPS is a payment gateway integration plugin designed specifically for WordPress websites, enabling seamless transactions for businesses and e-commerce stores. With this plugin, you can easily accept online payments from your customers, offering a smooth and secure checkout experience. This is not an official plugin from the connectIPS team.

Transform your WooCommerce store with the ConnectIPS Payment Gateway and provide your customers with a secure, fast, and convenient payment solution. Download the plugin now and take the first step toward enhancing your online sales experience!

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP 7.4 or greater is required (PHP 8.0 or greater is recommended)
  • MySQL 5.6 or greater, OR MariaDB version 10.1 or greater, is required

Automatic installation

Automatic installation is the easiest option — WordPress will handle the file transfer, and you won’t need to leave your web browser. To do an automatic install of WooCommerce, log in to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to the Plugins menu, and click “Add New.”

In the search field type “connectIPS,” then click “Search Plugins.” Once you’ve found us, you can view details about it such as the point release, rating, and description. Most importantly of course, you can install it by! Click “Install Now,” and WordPress will take it from there.

Manual installation

Manual installation method requires downloading the WooCommerce plugin and uploading it to your web server via your favorite FTP application. The WordPress codex contains instructions on how to do this here.

Updating

Automatic updates should work smoothly, but we still recommend you back up your site.
